stem: Explain whether or not people should make changes to traditional dishes.
instruction: Write a well-organized argumentative essay that uses specific evidence from the selections to support your answer. Manage your time carefully so that you can — review the selections, plan your response, write your response, revise and edit your response. Write your response in the box provided.
